big_case.notes: Although the petition frames an abstract constitutional challenge to judicial discipline under 28 U.S.C. § 354(a)(2)(A)(i) arising out of Judge Pauline Newman's suspension, this pro se collateral suit in the Court of Federal Claims sought no monetary relief, was dismissed at the threshold for lack of Tucker Act jurisdiction, was summarily affirmed by the Federal Circuit in a brief nonprecedential order under settled precedent, drew a government waiver, and was denied without dissent after one distribution.
